_comment: Copy-paste install snippets per project, shown on /p/<name> and as an Install link on cards. Each command was run before it was added here; record the date in verified.

snippets.label: Claude Code
snippets.code: claude mcp add mirc -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/b1tninja/mirc-mcp mirc-mcp

snippets.label: Then, once in mIRC
snippets.note: Copy mirc/mcp-bridge.mrc from the repository to %APPDATA%\mIRC first.

snippets.label: Fetch the corpus
snippets.note: Downloads the ASN.1 recommendations (about 14 MB) from itu.int into ~/.itulib. Nothing is redistributed.

snippets.label: Claude Code
snippets.code: claude mcp add --scope user itulib -- uvx --from "itulib[mcp] @ git+https://github.com/b1tninja-labs/itulib" itulib mcp

snippets.label: PowerShell
snippets.note: Runs the installer straight from GitHub. To read it first, open install.ps1 in the repository.

terraform-aws-strata.requires: Terraform or OpenTofu, and an AWS account with GPU quota

snippets.label: Module

faster-whisper-cuda-server.requires: Docker with the NVIDIA container toolkit

snippets.label: Docker Compose
snippets.code:
git clone https://github.com/b1tninja/faster-whisper-cuda-server.git
cd faster-whisper-cuda-server
docker compose up --build
snippets.note: Set HF_TOKEN in the environment or a .env file for authenticated model downloads.
